rationale: Use the released event catalogue as the faithful historical reference; do not recreate BeGaze by assuming our I-VT equals SMI High Speed Event Detection. Descriptor reports 4 deg/s peak threshold, while other SMI sources commonly report 40 deg/s.

30 deg/s and 100 ms anchor a conventional fixed-threshold comparator. This is deliberately not called a Tobii-equivalent filter because eyeprocesspy does not silently add Tobii's interpolation and merge stages.
Threshold-matched simple comparator motivated by multiple SMI BeGaze/RED250 reports using 40 deg/s and 50 ms. It is not claimed to reproduce proprietary BeGaze High Speed Event Detection.
1 degree and 100 ms are established dispersion-threshold settings and provide a conceptually distinct detector family.
